column2: AN  ACT TO AMEND THE CHARTERED INSTITUTE OF TRANSPORT OF

column1: BE it  enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :—

column2: This Act may be cited as the Chartered Institute of

column1: Transport  of  Sri  Lanka  (Incorporation)  (Amendment)  Act,

column2: The long title to the Chartered Institute of Transport

column1: of Sri Lanka (Incorporation) Act, No. 8 of 2000, (hereinafter
referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby amended
by  the  substitution,  for  the  words  “Chartered  Institute  of
Transport of Sri Lanka.” of the words “Chartered Institute of
Logistics and Transport of Sri Lanka.”.

column2: (1) In the principal enactment and in any other written

column1: law  there  shall  be  substituted  for  the  words  “Chartered
Institute of  Transport of Sri Lanka” wherever such words
appear in the principal enactment and such other written law
of the words “Chartered Institute of Logistics and Transport
of Sri Lanka”.

column2: (2) Every reference to the “Chartered Institute of  Transport

column1: of  Sri  Lanka”  in  any  notice,  notification,  contract,
communication  or  other  document  shall  be  read  and
construed as a reference to the “Chartered Institute of Logistics
and Transport of Sri Lanka”.

column2: For  the  avoidance  of  doubts  it  is  hereby  declared

column1: that the “Chartered Institute of Logistics and Transport of Sri
Lanka” shall for all purposes be deemed to be the successor
to the “Chartered Institute of Transport of Sri Lanka”.
